summary: BL-007 proposal-only authoring: 89 automated checks, 8 authoring browser checks and 15 CP-006 browser checks passed, with no failures or skipped checks. TypeScript and Worker build passed.
limitations: Tests use disposable loopback projects and local emulated identity. Simulated access failures do not certify hosted OAuth expiry or revocation.
Publication is tracked by Sites separately from this local test report. Requirement lifecycle statuses are unchanged.

checks.title: Author requirements with measurable acceptance criteria
checks.detail: Browser saves from accepted requirements choose/create a Draft; successful staging selects the saved requirement. Field validation and cancellation were exercised.

checks.title: Track meaningful requirement revisions
checks.detail: Domain/API tests verified stable IDs, base-relative revisions, equivalent-tag no-ops, restoration, and accepted revision changes only on Apply.

checks.title: Delete requirements without breaking references
checks.detail: Deletion confirmation, final dependency rejection, atomic dependent/target deletion, restore validation, and frozen-content retention passed.

checks.title: Provide validated reads and proposal-based batch requirement writes
checks.detail: API tests rejected missing/closed targets, invalid and oversized batches, invalid final dependencies, and stale saves without partial changes.

checks.title: Reconcile compatible imports without bypassing requirement review
checks.detail: Imports rejected accepted additions/deletions/revisions and ignored forged proposal outcomes; unchanged imports preserved authoritative history, metadata, snapshots and evidence.

checks.title: Expose browser tools for requirements assistants
checks.detail: A registered browser model-context fixture exercised read/save_requirements, explicit Draft targeting, rejection without a target, and accepted-set isolation.

checks.title: Review tag changes through the existing proposal workflow
checks.detail: Tag normalization, omitted tags, clearing, no-ops, proposal diffs, application, rebase, and immutable evidence/snapshot regressions passed.

checks.title: Keep accepted requirements unchanged until proposal application
checks.detail: Requirements/Changes share the proposal editor. REST/MCP staging, submission, rejection and request changes preserve accepted content; reviewed Apply promotes content without auto-approving lifecycle status.

checks.title: Select a proposal or latest accepted requirements in the main view
checks.detail: Browser checks exercised complete selected staged sets, search/tags, same-project context retention, deletion/restore, stale bases without overlay, closed-context recovery and read-only Proposed state.

checks.title: Choose or create a change proposal when saving an edit
checks.detail: Browser checks exercised existing/new destinations, cancellation, preexisting staged differences, live destination lifecycle updates and preserved creation fields.

checks.title: Preserve pending edits across proposal selection and save failures
checks.detail: Real D1 failure/restart and concurrent retry tests verified atomic creation and receipts; browser tests verified 409 reconciliation, pending navigation, uncertain saves, input typed in flight and uncommitted tag retention.

checks.title: Preserve proposal review and stale-base safeguards from the main view
checks.detail: Independent browsers and authenticated MCP exercised shared proposal diffs, review freshness, request changes, apply, coherent snapshot/history/evidence updates and preserved staged sets.

checks.title: Verify proposal-based editing and accepted-view isolation
checks.detail: 89 automated checks, 8 proposal-authoring browser checks and 15 live-update browser checks passed. TypeScript and Worker production build passed.

checks.title: Reject stale writes without losing newer changes
checks.detail: Version-gated writes and explicit reconciliation passed; stale/uncertain saves preserve input and original retry arguments.

checks.title: Provide clear loading, saving, and error feedback
checks.detail: Browser error/recovery checks preserved input and avoided false save success during outages and denied access.

checks.title: Automatically show saved changes from other users and MCP
checks.detail: Two independent browser sessions, a separate authenticated MCP client and another Worker converged within the five-second local target.

checks.title: Reconcile live updates using committed workspace versions
checks.detail: Conditional reads, unchanged 304 responses, coalescing, duplicate/out-of-order versions and cleanup passed.

checks.title: Preserve unsaved edits while remote changes arrive
checks.detail: Dirty requirements, destination forms, proposal review and snapshot metadata retained input and protected their save/review base across remote updates.

checks.title: Recover live synchronization and show connection state
checks.detail: Offline/online, server failure, denied access and browser suspension recovery passed in controlled local fixtures.

checks.title: Verify live updates across browser sessions and MCP
checks.detail: The full CP-006 browser suite ran with no skipped checks; recorded healthy visible-update samples ranged from 24 to 1794 ms.
